context.problem_statement: Given a dataset of financial transactions, identify the transaction with the highest anomaly score based on the transaction amount. Use a simple statistical technique such as the Z-score to compute the anomaly scores. Return the transaction ID and the anomaly score of the transaction with the highest score.
context.expert_knowledge: Anomaly detection can be performed using statistical methods like Z-score to identify outliers in continuous data such as transaction amounts. In financial fraud detection, extreme transaction values often indicate potential fraud.
